business_problem: Manual outreach slowed down the sales pipeline. With a sales team of just two employees, RealZips’ couldn’t afford the time spent manually researching prospects and crafting individually tailored emails.
solution_summary: Generative AI speeds up creating personalized outreach emails for reps by 10x. RealZips transformed its sales process by integrating zipcode-based data with website behavioral insights in Sales Cloud , giving sellers a unified view of leads. This unified data enables sellers to use pre-built Einstein Prompt Builder templates, tailored to specific use cases and industries, instead of writing emails from scratch. Each email is enriched with personalized data, including persona, demographics, and industry. For example, when targeting healthcare groups, Einstein Copilot generates emails that highlight RealZips’ benefits like enhanced targeting and improved access to care, based on the demand of the lead’s location. This automation reduces the time to craft a personalized email from 20 minutes to 2 minutes, enabling reps to reach 40% more new customers and boosting website traffic by 30% due to higher open rates.
